name: let the front page fetch its manifest and every app.json
FRONT PAGE: the Battlestar card exists and is not a phantom
eval: (function(){var c=[...document.querySelectorAll('a,article,div')].filter(e=>/Battlestar Overdrive/.test(e.textContent||''));return c.length? ('found in '+c.length+' nodes'):'NOT ON THE FRONT PAGE';})()

name: FRONT PAGE: its card links to the landing page
eval: (function(){var a=[...document.querySelectorAll('a')].find(x=>/battlestar-overdrive/.test(x.getAttribute('href')||''));return a? a.getAttribute('href'):'NO LINK TO THE SLUG';})()

name: FRONT PAGE: the preview image actually loaded
FRONT PAGE: it is filed as an effect, not a synth
eval: (function(){var a=[...document.querySelectorAll('a')].find(x=>/battlestar-overdrive/.test(x.getAttribute('href')||''));if(!a) return 'no card';var card=a.closest('article')||a;return /effect/i.test(card.textContent)? 'tagged effect':'NOT TAGGED EFFECT ('+card.textContent.slice(0,80)+')';})()

name: LANDING: the heading RENDERS as the product name (grep cannot see a split heading)
LANDING: the download and the manual are really there (HEAD, not hope)
eval: (async()=>{var out=[];for(const h of ['Battlestar-Overdrive-VST3-win64.zip','Battlestar-Overdrive-Manual.pdf']){try{const r=await fetch(h,{method:'HEAD'});out.push(h+' '+r.status+' '+Math.round((r.headers.get('content-length')||0)/1048576*10)/10+'MB');}catch(e){out.push(h+' FAILED');}}return out.join(' | ');})()

name: LANDING: no dead stablemate links in the footer
eval: (async()=>{var as=[...document.querySelectorAll('footer a')].filter(a=>/^\.\./.test(a.getAttribute('href')||''));var bad=[];for(const a of as){try{const r=await fetch(a.href,{method:'HEAD'});if(!r.ok) bad.push(a.getAttribute('href')+' '+r.status);}catch(e){bad.push(a.getAttribute('href')+' ERR');}}return bad.length? ('DEAD: '+bad.join(', ')):(as.length+' stablemate links all resolve');})()

name: LANDING: the build id on the page matches the one in the download name
eval: (function(){var t=document.body.textContent;var m=t.match(/Build\s+([0-9.]+)/i);return m? ('page says build '+m[1]):'NO BUILD ID ON THE PAGE';})()
